info.description: REST API for the Boilerplates Go + React starter kit
info.title: Boilerplates Backend API

get.description: Retrieve all areas with optional city_id filter, search, and pagination

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token

200.description: Login successful with token and user data

get.description: Retrieve all cities with optional province_id filter, search, and pagination
Retrieve all countries with optional search and pagination
Retrieve a single country by its UUID

put.description: Update an existing country by ID
Update authenticated user's profile information (full_name and password)

get.description: Get all addresses belonging to the authenticated user

post.summary: Create a new address for the current user

get.summary: Get a specific address of the current user

put.summary: Update an address of the current user

delete.summary: Delete an address of the current user

get.description: Retrieve all provinces with optional country_id filter, search, and pagination

post.description: Upload image or file for a specific resource and field

delete.description: Delete uploaded file and set database field to null

get.description: Retrieve all users with pagination and optional search filter. Only accessible by admin users.

post.description: Create a new user with email, password, full name, and role. Only accessible by admin users.

get.description: Retrieve a specific user by their ID. Only accessible by admin users.

put.description: Update user information including email, password, full name, and role. Only accessible by admin users.

delete.description: Delete a user by their ID. Only accessible by admin users.

get.description: Get all addresses for a specific user. Only accessible by admin users.
